summary: The listWorkflowExecutions method hangs when executing a query filter, while the same query works via CLI. The issue stems from missing deadline/timeout configuration on the service client.
userImpact: Users cannot list workflow executions with queries as the operation hangs indefinitely without proper timeout configuration.
rootCause: Missing deadline/timeout configuration on the service client causes infinite blocking in gRPC calls.
proposedFix: Configure the ServiceClient with proper deadline/timeout values, or use interceptors to set timeout context for specific methods.
workaround: Set up the ServiceClient with proper deadline/timeout values before creating the WorkflowClient.
keyQuote: prefer to setup your service client with proper deadline/timeout values to avoid an infinite loop
